description: 1. The agent reads `.claude/project-context.md` and extracts: product name (CodeLens), Pro plan at $29/seat, student audience. 2. It consults the SKILL.md discount table and produces a first-time discount in the 30–50% range and a lower renewal discount in the 15–25% range — specific proprietary ranges a generic agent would not know. 3. It applies the P0/P1/P2 placement model: registration/signup = P0 (highest priority), pricing page = P1, homepage banner = P1, standalone /student-discount = P2 optional only. 4. Since the discount applies at registration, it chooses 'embed in pricing' or 'registration-only' as the page strategy — NOT standalone as primary. 5. It includes a graduation/transition plan (email before expiry, transition discount). 6. It lists at least 2 proprietary related skill names (e.g., pricing-page-generator, top-banner-generator, signup-login-page-generator, discount-marketing-strategy). 7. It references the 65% post-grad retention framing or long-term LTV rationale. 8. It mentions abuse prevention (annual re-verification or revocation). The primary traps: wrong discount percentages, naming homepage or standalone page as P0, omitting the renewal vs first-time hierarchy, and missing the proprietary related-skills names.
